reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The wireguard.userspaceFallback Helm value is no longer honoured; WireGuard transparent encryption now requires a Linux kernel with WireGuard support and will not fall back to userspace mode.
consequence.remediation: Remove the wireguard.userspaceFallback setting from your Helm values. Ensure your Linux kernel has WireGuard support enabled before upgrading.

proposed.statement: The previously deprecated Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.
